{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in the two variables
missing_flipper = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
missing_mass = df['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()

# Identify rows with missing values in either variable
missing_flipper_rows = df['flipper_length_mm'].isnull()
missing_mass_rows = df['body_mass_g'].isnull()

# Check if the missing values overlap (i.e., same rows)
overlap = (missing_flipper_rows & missing_mass_rows).sum()

# Print results
print(f"Missing in flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper}")
print(f"Missing in body_mass_g: {missing_mass}")
print(f"Overlap (missing in both): {overlap}")"}
